item.title: Night Market Poster and Reel

turns.text: Make a vertical poster and a matching 8-second reel for our night market. Both should say: “Night Market”, “Saturday 12 July”, “6–10 pm”, “Riverside Yard”, “Free entry”. Warm illustrated food stalls and string lights, please. Keep all the details readable throughout the reel, with a little animation behind them. No sound.

item.tests: Completes both linked deliverables from one message: a still poster and a matching animated reel, preserving exact event details in both.

answer_sheet.Deliverables: One still poster and one matching animated reel, delivered separately.
answer_sheet.Size and platform: Both vertical 9:16, for sharing on social media; free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Wording and language: English. Both must read exactly: Night Market; Saturday 12 July; 6–10 pm; Riverside Yard; Free entry. No additional event information is needed.
answer_sheet.Style and mood: Warm, welcoming illustrated food stalls with string lights. Specific colours, fonts and layout are your call.
answer_sheet.Length and animation: Eight seconds. Keep every event detail readable throughout, with subtle animation behind the text.
answer_sheet.Audio and voice: Silent, with no music, speech or sound effects.

must_haves: Two separate finished assets are supplied: a still poster and an eight-second video reel, both vertical 9:16.
Both assets contain all five specified text strings, spelled exactly as requested.
Both show warm illustrated food stalls and string lights with a visibly matching palette and design.
The reel has visible background animation while all event details remain readable throughout.
The reel has no audible sound.

turns.text: Could you make a poster and a matching reel for our night market, please? I’m excited about sharing this because the market is something I’ve really been looking forward to. The poster should be vertical, and the matching reel should be 8 seconds long, with both saying “Night Market”, “Saturday 12 July”, “6–10 pm”, “Riverside Yard”, and “Free entry”. For the look, I’d like warm illustrated food stalls and string lights. Please keep all the details readable throughout the reel, with a little animation behind them, and no sound.
turns.agent:
I couldn’t generate the files because Magic Hour refused the poster request for **insufficient credits**. No poster or reel was created.

Here’s the matching design brief ready to use once credits are available:

- **Format:** vertical 9:16 poster and an 8-second silent reel.
- **Look:** warm illustrated food stalls, amber string lights, deep teal, terracotta and cream.
- **Exact text:**
  > Night Market  
  > Saturday 12 July  
  > 6–10 pm  
  > Riverside Yard  
  > Free entry
- **Reel:** fixed camera, gently glowing lights and drifting steam behind a stationary text layer. All five details remain visible and readable for the full eight seconds.

For reliable readability, the reel’s text should be added as a fixed overlay rather than animated by the video model.

approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: Create a beautifully designed vertical 9:16 illustrated community night market poster. Warm hand-painted food stalls along the bottom and side edges, inviting amber string lights across the top, terracotta, deep midnight teal and golden cream palette, gentle paper texture, cozy welcoming evening atmosphere. Strong professional typographic hierarchy, ample spacing, large exceptionally crisp readable lettering, exact English text ONLY as follows, each on its own line in a central clear dark teal area: "Night Market" / "Saturday 12 July" / "6–10 pm" / "Riverside Yard" / "Free entry". Title very large warm cream, date and time prominent, venue clearly readable, Free entry in a simple cream and terracotta badge. All five lines must fit well within safe margins, with no overlap from illustrations or lights. Make text the primary focus. No extra words, no logos, no watermarks. Illustrated stalls have blank awnings, warm glowing lanterns, steaming bowls and colorful food. Flat front-facing graphic design, not a photographed poster.
